en.intro: (ph,co,firm)=>firm?"It's time to prepare "+ph+' for '+co+'. To get this done, please send us the following:':'Thank you for letting us know about '+ph+' for '+co+'. To prepare this, please send us the following:'
en.head: n=>'For the '+n.toLowerCase()+':'
en.on: l=>"We already hold these on file, so there's no need to send them again: "+l+'.'
en.link: u=>'You can upload documents and complete any identity checks securely here:\n'+u
en.invc: (no,a,n)=>'Our invoice '+no+' for '+a+' is attached, payable within '+n+" days. We've already started work on this."
en.remind: (no,a,iss,due)=>'A gentle reminder that our invoice '+no+' for '+a+', issued on '+iss+', was due on '+due+' and is still showing as unpaid. If you have already paid, thank you, and please ignore this message.'
en.inv: (no,a)=>'Our invoice '+no+' for '+a+" is attached. We'll start work as soon as payment is received."
en.cr: (d,r)=>'This needs to reach the Companies Registry by '+d+", so we'd be grateful for the details by "+r+'.'
en.ev: n=>'Once the change takes effect we have '+n+' days to file it with the Companies Registry, so please send these as soon as you can.'
en.other: (d,r)=>'The deadline is '+d+", so we'd be grateful for the details by "+r+'.'
en.bye:
Best regards,
Karen Yip
Harbourline Corporate Services
en.chase: (ph,co)=>'A quick reminder on '+ph+' for '+co+". We're still waiting for:"
en.same: u=>'You can send them through the same secure link:\n'+u
en.done: (n,co)=>'We have completed '+n+' for '+co+'. The updated records are available in your client portal, and a copy of the filed documents is attached.'
en.thanks: Thank you for your prompt help with this.
